verdict.rationale: Intel's own marketing pages assert strong gaming performance (Arc graphics, XeSS 3, FPS-boosting tools, wide game library support) — see docs-4, docs-6, docs-16, docs-19 — but the evidence pack contains no independent game benchmarks or third-party hands-on reviews validating these frame-rate claims. Missing for 10: independent/third-party game benchmark results, comparative FPS data vs competing chips, cache/boost-clock technical specifics tied to measured gaming performance.
